dish.note: Cola over ice with cherry syrup and a twist of orange, sharp as Tango's suit in the mess line.
dish.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 2 tbsp cherry syrup to each, top with cold cola and stir once. Drop in a cocktail cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
dish.make_ahead: Chill the cola well ahead; build each glass to serve

steps.text: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and add 2 tbsp cherry syrup to each.
Top with cold cola, stir once, add a cherry and twist orange peel over the top.
